title: Elevated upload failures in eu-west-1
summary: A storage node in eu-west-1 is returning intermittent rejections on uploads over 50 MB. Roughly 3% of uploads in that region are affected. Retrying usually succeeds.
workaround: Retry the upload from a fresh page load. Files under 50 MB are unaffected.

title: Delayed webhook delivery
summary: A backlog in the delivery queue delayed webhooks by up to 40 minutes. No events were lost; all were delivered after the backlog drained.

title: Duplicate charge batch on 2026-09-02
summary: A retry in the payment processor captured a small batch of monthly invoices twice on 2026-09-02. Affected customers have two identical paid invoices dated 2026-09-02. Refunds are being issued on request and case by case by the billing team.
workaround: Contact support with both invoice IDs; the duplicate is refunded in full.

title: SSO sign-in failures for Okta tenants
summary: A certificate rotation on our side invalidated cached IdP metadata for some Okta tenants, producing ERR_1104 on sign-in.
workaround: Re-upload the metadata XML under Settings > Security > SSO.

title: Mobile app stale data on Android 15
summary: Background refresh is being suspended aggressively by the OS on some Android 15 devices, leaving the app showing data up to a day old.
workaround: Pull to refresh, or sign out and back in to force a full resync.
